title: Poisoned Dinner Party
story:
On a chilly evening at the posh mansion of millionaire industrialist, Mr. Jameson, a dinner party was organized to celebrate his latest business deal. Among the guests were close friends and associates:

1. Mrs. Emily Jameson (brother-in-law),
2. Mr. Robert Wilson (business partner),
3. Dr. Susan Smith (toxicologist),
4. Mr. Andrew Foster (rival businessman).
crimeScene: The mansion's opulent dining room. The table was adorned with an exquisite feast prepared by the best chef, yet the guests reported feeling strange symptoms.
victim: Mr. William Jameson (host) - found slumped over in his chair, motionless.
forensicClue: The poisoned wine glass left untouched on the table, with a distinct silver taint.
question: Who poisoned Mr. Jameson and how? Find the poisoned wine glass to piece together the story.
options: Option A (The poison was introduced in the kitchen by Mrs. Emily Jameson)
Option B (Mr. Andrew Foster poisoned the wine during the handshake)
Option C (Dr. Susan Smith tampered with the wine after the dinner started)
Option D (Mr. Robert Wilson added the poison at the last minute)?
